_comment: Model registry for the design-iteration harness.
Contract: every model is invoked non-interactively, receives the brief on stdin,
and PRINTS a complete HTML document to stdout. The runner extracts the document
and writes it to disk. Models never write files themselves — that keeps the
invocation uniform across four different CLIs and avoids tool-permission setup.
'available' is verified, not assumed. Re-check with: node tools/generate.mjs --check

models.label: Claude Opus
models.note: claude 2.1.220. -p prints the response and exits.

models.label: Claude Fable
models.note: Same CLI as opus, different --model. If the alias is rejected, the runner reports it rather than silently falling back.

models.label: OpenAI (Codex CLI)
models.note: codex-cli 0.144.3, authed via ~/.codex/auth.json. 'exec' is the non-interactive mode. Output includes session chatter, so the runner extracts the HTML document from it.

models.label: Kimi
models.note: kimi -p takes the prompt as a flag VALUE, not stdin. --auto runs fully autonomously without asking questions.

models.label: OpenCode
models.note: Installed but not enabled by default — it is a multi-provider router, so which model actually answers is ambiguous, which defeats the point of comparing models. Flip available to true and pin a provider if you want it in the pool.
